https://brandefense.io/security-news/cyb.title: CyberStrikeAI attacks explained
https://brandefense.io/security-news/cyb.overview: Brandefense explains how the open-source CyberStrikeAI platform, which chains 100+ security tools under an LLM agent, was tied to AI-assisted attacks on FortiGate appliances.

https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/thr.title: Detecting agentic offensive frameworks: ARTEX and friends
https://www.elastic.co/security-labs/thr.overview: Elastic Security Labs lists CyberStrikeAI's operator console, implant builder and WebShell manager: User-Agent 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; CyberStrikeAI-WebShell/1.0)' with a 'pass' field, an OSPROBE echo, 'SystemUpdate' persistence, five-second check-ins without jitter, and proxy, User-Agent and Tor fallbacks when blocked.

https://blog.talosintelligence.com/artex.title: ARTEX and beyond
https://blog.talosintelligence.com/artex.overview: Cisco Talos saw CyberStrikeAI co-deployed with ARTEX on the same infrastructure, alongside scanners such as Fscan and C2 such as VShell and AdaptixC2.

https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/arte.title: ARTEX and AI-powered red teaming tools
https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/arte.overview: Unit 42 counted 1,323 internet-facing CyberStrikeAI hosts in October 2026 and describes agent timing such as short request bursts and fast retries.

https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/ai.title: AI-augmented threat actor accesses FortiGate devices at scale
https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/security/ai.overview: Amazon Threat Intelligence reports 600+ FortiGate devices in 55 countries reached through exposed management ports (443, 8443, 10443, 4443) and weak or stolen credentials, followed by gogo, Nuclei, DCSync, pass-the-hash and attacks on Veeam (CVE-2023-27532, CVE-2024-40711).

https://www.team-cymru.com/post/tracking.title: Tracking CyberStrikeAI usage
https://www.team-cymru.com/post/tracking.overview: Team Cymru tied the FortiGate campaign address 212.11.64.250 to a 'CyberStrikeAI' banner on port 8080 and tracked 21 CyberStrikeAI server addresses between January and February 2026.
